title: The newsroom publishes on its own schedule
description: Milestone: first a piece by hand, then monitors, ideas, drafts, pictures and review requests without a person starting each one.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan 2026-11-18: next goal is a daily joke cycle run by always-on agents. One agent files a batch of invented premises each day; another picks the funniest and it is drafted, ending at a review request (a person still approves, decision 13). Papyrus work filed: PPY-97e2db (scheduled ideation agent, invented premises, N per run as data), PPY-8ffd58 (selection by the site's own criteria, a humour rubric, batch mode with ranked reasons), PPY-69fbaa (selection as a scheduled agent; blocked by 97e2db and PPY-8fe7e6, the site's own Story procedure). Site side here: save the newsroom data (mission, policy, sections, guidelines), write the humour rubric, adopt both agents, rung draft.
